title: Return real release and distribution collections
objective: get_asset gives clients the actual context required for follow-up calls.
outcome: HCRIS has positive contextual collections derived from catalog locators that agree with the public detail page. An unbound product stays explicitly unknown. Known-empty versus not-yet-resolved collections remain distinguishable. Pagination across a generation change returns a typed restart. Limits never silently clip required context. Tests obtain IDs from actual get_asset output and do not inject fake release IDs. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. GitHub PR12 was merged by the user to main as 5d5a30ca; this bind starts from research HEAD 37521968 after that merge.
